display_long_description:
Challenge your friends to the classic strategy board game of Chess. A beautiful mixed-reality rendition of Chess awaits you, with direct hand input and physics-based interaction, so you can play the classic the way you want to play.

[media]

# ♟️ LICHESS integration
Use your own account to play chess with others in Lichess directly in VR. Quick Pairing of:

- 10+0 Rapid  
- 10+5 Rapid  
- 15+10 Rapid  
- 30+0 Classical  

[media]

# 🎨 Customize your experience
And if you're feeling creative, you can use the Boxtree Builder to remix the game to best suit your personal style, with your own custom King, Queen, Rook, Knight, Bishop, and Pawn piece designs.

[media]

# 🌌 Play your way
Seamlessly transition between passthrough mixed-reality mode and a fully immersive skybox experience via Table Space's magical skybox marbles. Enjoy the game how you want to for free in Table Space, and let your imagination run wild.

[media]

# ⚙️ Gameplay improvements
This latest update also brings powerful gameplay improvements to make your matches smoother and more intuitive:

- See valid moves for selected piece.  
- Automatic rollback of invalid moves.  
- Automatic castling to either side when valid.  
- Automatic check, checkmate, and draw detection for stalemate or insufficient material.  
- New round cleanup button to instantly reset the game.  
- Last move highlight so you never miss a move.  
- Captured pieces are automatically moved to the captured zone.  
- Turn indicator. 

[media]
